task: SHELFCHECK -- TARGETED RECENT PS4 PHYSICAL OMISSION CHECK (fix/recent-ps4-physical-omissions)
scope: Narrow, targeted correction triggered by a known missing title (Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 + 4), followed by a bounded 2024-2026 recent-release sanity check. This is explicitly NOT a full census rebuild or broad historical audit -- 8 candidate titles were individually investigated (the confirmed omission plus 7 other plausible 2024-2026 PS4 candidates suggested by the same pattern), matching the task's 'narrow' mandate. No subagents were used.

confirmedOmissions.title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 + 4
confirmedOmissions.verifiedAbsentBeforeAdding: Confirmed via direct search of the finalized runtime census (all items, aliases, and products) for 'tony hawk' before making any change -- only Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 1 + 2 (id 1340) and Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 5 (id 1767) existed; no '3 + 4' identity.
confirmedOmissions.physicalEvidence: Target.com product listing (https://www.target.com/p/tony-hawk-pro-skater-3-4-playstation-4/-/A-94650080): exact title 'Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 + 4 - PlayStation 4', format explicitly listed as 'Physical' disc, UPC 196388575534, publisher Activision, release date July 11, 2025, launch price $39.99. Corroborated by GameStop and Best Buy both separately listing a standalone PS4 product page for the same title (GameStop product 20015170, Best Buy SKU JJGXPXWZ4Y), and by PlayStation's own blog post 'Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 + 4 launches July 11 on PS5 and PS4' confirming a native PS4 release (not just PS5 back-compat).
confirmedOmissions.eligibilityReasoning: Physical PS4 disc confirmed (not digital-only) -- qualifies under existing core eligibility rules. Not PSVR-required, not an annual/serialized sports title, not shovelware. The PS Store 'Cross-Gen Edition'/'Digital Deluxe Edition' listings are separate digital-only cross-buy bundle SKUs distinct from the physical retail disc; this identity represents the standalone physical PS4 release, matching the existing one-identity-per-game convention (edition-name variants are treated as physical-product variants of the same identity elsewhere in this census, e.g. Dragon Ball: The Breakers).
confirmedOmissions.proposedTreatment: Single new INCLUDED identity (id 2784, 'Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 + 4'). No DATA.p product entry created -- this is a single-identity title, not a multi-identity compilation, so collectionInfo()'s product mechanism does not apply.
confirmedOmissions.priceStatus: PRICE PENDING (max left null). PriceCharting (pricecharting.com) returned HTTP 403 to this session's fetch tool, the same tooling limitation documented in every prior pricing pass this engagement -- no independently-verified secondary-market CIB price source was available. Target's $39.99 is a current/recent retail listing price, not a verified aftermarket CIB figure, and was deliberately NOT used as a substitute per the task's explicit instruction to use PRICE PENDING rather than guess.
confirmedOmissions.coverStatus: Mapped. Official PlayStation Store cover image (https://image.api.playstation.com/vulcan/ap/rnd/202502/2100/5a082446577b5f38ca04bf9bac67726fcbe0bc61baf6de7b.png), confirmed as the SAME image served by both the PS4/PS5 'Content Pack' and 'Cross-Gen Edition' PS Store listings for this title (i.e. the standard-edition key art), which publishers consistently reuse as the physical retail box art. Verified reachable (HTTP 200, image/jpeg, 864,761 bytes) and confirmed rendering live in the app.
confirmedOmissions.aliasReasoning: norm() already maps '&' to ' and ' and strips punctuation, so 'Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 & 4' normalizes identically to the stored title. These two aliases are a defensive safety net for GameEye export title formats that spell out 'and' as a separate word or omit the '+' entirely.
